program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (mask color)
      (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g color))))
        (grid-from-fn (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1)
                      (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1)
          (lambda (r c)
            (if (= (at g (+ (first bb) r) (+ (second bb) c)) color) 1 0)))))
    (let* ((a (mask 2))
           (b (mask 3))
           (h (max (rows a) (rows b)))
           (w (max (cols a) (cols b)))
           (xor-grid
            (grid-from-fn h w
              (lambda (r c)
                (let ((av (and (< r (rows a)) (< c (cols a)) (= (at a r c) 1)))
                      (bv (and (< r (rows b)) (< c (cols b)) (= (at b r c) 1))))
                  (if (or (and av (not bv)) (and bv (not av))) 8 0))))))
      (crop-to-content xor-grid))))
